Install and read packages

The posters

Read them in order. Everything you need for the exercises is in them.

1A package is a bag, a library is what is inside

2tidyverse: one box, many tools

3Ten packages, installed and read

Your turn: ten scenarios

Each one is a situation with a person and a folder. Write the line of R they need and press Check. The marking is exact: every bracket, quote and capital letter has to be right, just as R requires. Spacing is the only thing forgiven.

0 of 10 correct
1

Fatmata has a brand new laptop and needs the tidyverse for the first time. Write the line that downloads it.

The function has a dot in the middle, and the name goes in quotes.

2

Fatmata opens R the next morning. The tidyverse is already on her laptop. Write the line she needs so she can use it today.

Opening the bag, not buying it again. No quotes needed here.

3

Musa runs ggplot() and R says could not find function "ggplot", although he installed ggplot2 last week. Write the one line that fixes it.

Installed is not the same as opened.

4

Isata is sent an Excel file and needs the openxlsx package, which she has never used. Write the line she runs first, once only.

First time on this computer means install, with the name in quotes.

5

And now write the line Isata runs in every session after that.

Every session, and no quotes.

6

Sahr has messy column names and wants janitor. Write both lines, the install first and the read second.

Two lines, in the order the poster shows.

7

Aminata writes library("dplyr") and it works, but her trainer says to drop the quotes. Write the line the way the poster does it.

library takes the name plainly.

8

Alhaji needs to work with dates and the poster recommends lubridate. He has never installed it. Write both lines he needs.

Install once, then read it.

9

Kadiatu cannot remember which packages are already loaded in her session. Write the command from the Common functions list that shows her.

Six letters and empty brackets.

10

Mohamed wants the help page for the readr package before he uses it. Write the command.

Four letters, and the package name plainly inside.
